description: Search a platform by query for ads, advertisers, albums, channels, comments, communities, events, groups, hashtags, issues, jobs, places, playlists, podcasts, posts, products, profiles, repositories, sounds, suggestions or top. Pass platform, type and query. Types by platform: amazon: products; applemusic: albums, profiles, playlists, posts; bluesky: posts; facebook: ads, advertisers, events, groups, products, places, posts, profiles; github: issues, profiles, repositories; google: ads, profiles, suggestions; hackernews: comments, posts; instagram: hashtags, places, posts, profiles, sounds, suggestions; linkedin: ads, jobs, posts, profiles; pinterest: posts; reddit: comments, posts, profiles, communities; rumble: posts; spotify: albums, profiles, playlists, podcasts, posts; telegram: channels; threads: posts, profiles; tiktok: ads, hashtags, posts, profiles, sounds, suggestions, top; tiktokshop: products; x: communities, hashtags, posts, profiles; youtube: posts, profiles, suggestions. Price per successful page: Amazon, Apple Music, Bluesky, GitHub, Google, Hacker News, Instagram, Pinterest, Reddit, Rumble, Spotify, Threads, TikTok Shop, YouTube: 1 credit. Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, TikTok, X: 1 credit + 1 per result filled in (with fill=true). Follow next_cursor while it is set; a short page is not the end. It also takes each platform's own filters (such as kind or author), not listed here: find_endpoint's params name them for each search.

country.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Region: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US or BR (case-insensitive).

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the next page, or the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions; full returns every field. Same price.

fill.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). true also fetches each result's full, current record from the platform into details (exact counts, its ID).

lang.description: Only for Apple Music (every type), Bluesky posts, Facebook ads, Spotify (every type), YouTube suggestions. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

limit.description: Items per page, up to the endpoint's page size (the default; larger values are reduced to it). Omit it for the cheapest walk: a page costs the same whatever its limit.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

period.description: Only for Facebook products, LinkedIn jobs. The time window, in days back from the platform's latest update; each endpoint lists its values.

since.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Only items at or after this time: RFC 3339 (2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) or a date (2026-10-01, midnight UTC).

sort.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Order of the results.

status.description: Only for Facebook ads, GitHub issues, TikTok ads. Only active items, only inactive ones, or both (all).

type.description: What to search for. Each platform searches some types (the tool's description lists them).

until.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Only items before this time (exclusive): RFC 3339 or a date (midnight UTC).

name: search
title: Search by query
